Who We Are

A shop built on straight answers, not sales talk

H.I Mobile Shop has been on Railway Road for years, run by Zain Bhai and known locally for stocking pieces that actually last — no copies dressed up as originals.

Ask what a charger or earphone is really made of and you'll get a straight answer, in person or over WhatsApp.

  • ✓ Genuine brands, tested before they hit the shelf
  • ✓ Fair, fixed pricing — no bargaining games
  • ✓ WhatsApp ordering with same-day pickup
  • ✓ Honest advice on what will actually fit your phone
